findings.claim: The canonical WI-546 prerequisite set (545+547+549+550+551+552) is not mirrored in three secondary surfaces, which still state the pre-SOL-004 four-predecessor set.
findings.analysis: The SOL-004 remediation fixed the WI-546 header, the manifest handoff DAG, and reconciliation section 3, all of which now require six predecessors including WI-551 and WI-552. However the INDEX.md WI-546 row says 'integration after 545/547/549/550', the reconciliation section 1 disposition row for WI-546 says 'After 545/547/549/550', and the SOLUTION-CONFIDENCE action packet row 'Keep WI-546 as the live acceptance wave' says 'After 545/547/549/550'. All three omit WI-551 and WI-552. An implementer scheduling from INDEX or the disposition table could start the WI-546 live wave before the dispatch resolver and restart continuation land, which would make its restart-continuation and no-remap fixtures (AC-546-3, AC-546-6) unexecutable or falsely scoped.
findings.proposed_fix: Update the INDEX.md WI-546 row, the reconciliation section 1 WI-546 disposition row, and the SOLUTION-CONFIDENCE action-packet row to the full six-predecessor set 545/547/549/550/551/552, matching the canonical DAG.

findings.claim: The manifest Files Planned table no longer matches the actual changeset: WI-545.md is declared KEEP but is modified, and one committed file is absent from the table entirely.
findings.analysis: git diff origin/main...HEAD --name-status shows 'M docs/specs/work-items/WI-545.md' (25 insertions: the SOL-003 ACs, focused tests, rollback, and cost sections) while manifest line 51 still declares WI-545 as 'KEEP | already on origin/main via PR #10; do not fork'. The diff also contains 'A docs/specs/planning-imports/wi-547/HEAD-meta.txt', which appears nowhere in the Files Planned table. The table is the plan's declared scope; a mechanical or human check comparing declared actions to the diff either false-passes (unlisted file) or false-fails (KEEP file with modifications), and a later child planner reading the manifest would not know WI-545's ACs were extended in this branch.
evidence: git diff origin/main...HEAD --name-status (shows M docs/specs/work-items/WI-545.md and A docs/specs/planning-imports/wi-547/HEAD-meta.txt)
findings.proposed_fix: Change the WI-545 row action to MODIFY with a note 'add SOL-003 planning ACs/tests/rollback/cost; implementation stays a later child', and add a row for docs/specs/planning-imports/wi-547/HEAD-meta.txt (CREATE, WI-547 reference snapshot).

findings.claim: The reconciliation document header still declares the plan base as origin/main a4d0efa3, a residual of the pre-rebase state that SOL-002 remediation missed.
findings.analysis: Reconciliation line 6 reads 'Base: origin/main a4d0efa3'. The manifest declares Base SHA 223436abe5124e6d9852551d249efd855759833b and the live merge-base with origin/main confirms 223436ab. a4d0efa3 is the pre-PR-#10 main that the WI-542/543 runtime was proven on, not the base of this plan. The body of the reconciliation was correctly rebased onto landed reality (sections 3, 4, 5), but a reader anchoring child dispositions to the header base would reconcile against a superseded main that lacks PR #10, PR #11 (WI-547), and PR #12.
findings.proposed_fix: Change the reconciliation Base line to origin/main 223436ab (post PR #10/#11/#12), optionally noting a4d0efa3 only as the historical SHA on which WI-542/543 runtime behavior was proven.

findings.claim: The review-log's last recorded independent verdict is fail (rubric 4) while its quality gate reports independent_sol_review PASS and terminal_state REVISED_AND_REVIEWED, with no post-remediation review round bound to the remediated tree.
findings.analysis: tier2 records verdict fail and rubric_score 4 from the pre-remediation tree. All eight findings are dispositioned ACCEPT and applied in 45843ad4, rounds_run stays 1, lens_rechecks is empty, and quality_gates.independent_sol_review says PASS. A consumer that reads the verdict field concludes the plan failed independent review; one that reads the gate concludes it passed. Neither field is bound to evidence that the remediated tree was re-examined. The bounded-review protocol permits terminal exit on full disposition, but the log as written leaves a contradictory authority record: the PASS gate is not backed by any recorded passing verdict.
findings.proposed_fix: Append a round-2 entry recording the post-remediation residual review (this Fable pass), with its verdict, rubric score, findings, and the commit it examined; rename or annotate the gate to 'independent_review_ran: PASS' versus 'independent_review_verdict', so verdict and gate cannot be read as contradicting.

findings.claim: The architecture document's ASCII dependency drawing shows WI-545, WI-549, and WI-550 feeding WI-552, contradicting the canonical hard edges everywhere else (WI-552 depends only on WI-551, WI-547, and WI-502).
findings.analysis: In the Dependency DAG figure, the connector line '+----+-------------+----------+----------+----> WI-552' joins the columns under WI-547, WI-545, WI-549, WI-550, and WI-551 into WI-552. The canonical DAG in the manifest handoff section, reconciliation section 3 ('after WI-551: WI-552'), and the WI-552 header ('Depends on: WI-551, WI-547, WI-502') give WI-552 only two in-plan predecessors. The prose is consistent; only the drawing over-constrains. An implementer trusting the figure would needlessly serialize WI-552 behind three independent WIs, delaying the WI-546 wave.
findings.proposed_fix: Redraw the ASCII figure so only WI-551 (and the landed WI-547 / existing WI-502 inputs) feed WI-552, with WI-545/549/550/553 feeding only WI-546, matching the canonical hard-edge list.
